rationale: Second scenario of the accepted requirement c-client-request-completes-on-inactive-raft, and the case its review recorded as outside the first check's prefix: a request the API accepts while the node is still leading and that a later shutdown leaves unresolved. No new obligation or map change is needed, because the accepted claim's scope already covers the window in which a client call is raced with Shutdown; the check is attached to the existing unit and uses its selected binding. The harness parks a single-voter leader inside its own dispatch path with a gated LogStore, queues more requests than the documented BatchApplyCh buffer can hold, and then shuts the node down, so some requests are accepted by the API and left in the buffer once the goroutine join has completed.
